clips.title: The story
paras: In Teldrassil, Training the Beast sends night elf hunters from the wilds to Darnassus. After taming beasts among the boughs, they learn pet care and discipline from Jocaste.

Dazalar sends you from the wilds near Dolanaar to Darnassus once you prove you can tame a beast. Before you travel Kalimdor with a loyal companion, you need to learn more than how to use a taming rod. Subduing a wild creature tests your strength and will, but an untrained beast can still be unpredictable.

Jocaste teaches you the arts of caring for a companion in Darnassus's Cenarion Enclave. She shows you how to feed your pet, bring it back if tragedy strikes, and train it to fight. For night elves, this bond reflects reverence for nature, not simple control.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills to train it.
Travel to Darnassus. There you must speak to one of our most revered adventurers, Jocaste. She will give you the ability to train your new pet, so make haste.
While Jocaste may seem stern, she is always pleased to see another adventurer rising through the ranks. Treat her with respect and she will return in kind. Good luck, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: A fledgling adventurer, I see. Yes, I can bestow you with the skills you need to train and guide your pet. Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, you will now be able to feed your pet, as well as revive it, should it fall in battle.
Remember, friend, always respect the balance and live in awe of nature around you. Now, go forth. We shall speak again, at a later date.
